name: Modern Ru Kiln Celadon Tea Set
marketing_tip: Celebrate the 'beauty of imperfection' with the delicate cicada-wing crackles of Ru Kiln porcelain.
body: This Ru Kiln set is characterized by its soft, sky-blue glaze and fine network of crackles that will deepen and evolve with use. It includes a functional tea tray, providing everything you need for a complete and elegant ceremony.
original_title: 汝窑茶具套装家用泡茶专用陶瓷茶杯盖碗茶盘高档喝茶茶具新款定制
